entities.summary: Józef Michalik is a Polish Roman Catholic bishop, the diocesan Bishop of the Zielona Góra-Gorzów diocese in 1986-1993, Archbishop of Przemyśl in 1993–2016, and the president of the Polish Episcopal Conference in 2004–2014.
